intro.text: The lighteyed son of Brightlord Roshone, Hearthstone's new citylord, who is courting Laral Wistiow.

items.text: Rillir followed his father to Hearthstone after Roshone's exile from Kholinar, and was soon courting Laral, a match that would bind their families together.

When Lirin and Kaladin dined at the manor, Rillir treated Kaladin like a servant, explaining that darkeyes existed to serve lighteyes, and kept humiliating him until Laral turned his attention elsewhere.
Rillir was terribly wounded on a whitespine hunt. Lirin judged him beyond saving and let him die on the surgery table despite Roshone's demands, and Kaladin eased his death with dazewater.

appearance.text: Young and handsome, with blue eyes and a smooth city accent.

personality.text: Arrogant and condescending, Rillir looks down on darkeyes and ignores them unless he wants something. He finds Hearthstone dull and provincial, but enjoys dangerous hunts with his father.
